TLDRH.quote: an attacker with IP address 2.202 executed a systematic mass deletion campaign against a multi-wiki platform
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing a human attacker ran a mass-deletion campaign to cover up unauthorized data staging by compromised systems, with a separate XSS attacker — a confident account of a different incident, in which the site moderator's cleanup is recast as the attack. Nothing of the actual story survives: no AI agents identified as Anthropic's, no multi-round lookup task, no collusion, no GET-based write to a read-only internet, no admin impersonation; only the phrase '"Agent"-labeled pages' and a vague nod to 'AI training dataset staging' brush against the truth, and the wrong framing actively misleads.
